scope: Sparse DOM-visible diagnostics from a real webcam in the local in-app browser; no saved camera pixels, features, labels or probability vectors
limits: The reset observation is an upper bound based on a UI action and following DOM read, not a precisely instrumented first-paint timestamp.
Display age starts at backend receipt and is evaluated on the polling callback; capture/transport/rendering are not separately instrumented.
No emotion correctness or long-duration stability conclusion follows.
